# Keep saved entries in sync across open workspace tabs

## What & Why
The workspace stores answers and applications in browser storage, so changes made in one open tab can leave another tab showing stale cards. Synchronizing storage changes would prevent edits from appearing lost or being overwritten by an older view.

## Done looks like
- Opening the workspace in two tabs reflects answer and application changes in both tabs
- A tab refreshes its local view when another tab saves or deletes an entry
- Browser coverage verifies the synchronization behavior
